name: Break-Glass Authority
description: Emergency override with mandatory audit: who, what, when, why, and mandatory post-hoc review.
purpose: Emergencies have a path, but it leaves a trail.
acceptanceCriteria: Break-glass override can bypass normal policy evaluation.
Every break-glass event records: who, what, when, why.
Break-glass authority is time-boxed and auto-revokes after the emergency window.
Post-hoc review is mandatory within a configurable SLA.
Failure to complete post-hoc review escalates to council.
